blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — WWF-Philippines is renewing its marine conservation and environmental monitoring work in Nasugbu, Batangas, including surveys that could help determine areas suitable for coral reef restoration. The initiative will generate updated environmental data to support the long-term management of marine ecosystems, particularly marine protected areas in the coastal area. One of the planned activities is a site selection survey at Pico de Loro Cove to assess its ecological suitability for a possible artificial coral reef project.
